notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
This small patch makes custom characters have a workshop tag in case they have a voice line so they are easier to find. It also improves the menu behavior when creating a new character.

That's it for now, open to suggestions for the game!

notes.title: New mode and minor tweaks
notes.content:
This patch adds an endless mode where you can spawn entities with your mouse or with keyboard shortcuts with no end
It also adds an hp bar and damage indicators
Some minor bugfixes

That's it for now!
